info.title: Blades of the Guardians
info.synopsis: Dao Ma, un misterioso cacciatore di taglie, viaggia nelle regioni più remote dell'impero accompagnato dal piccolo Xiao Qi. Quando accetta un incarico che lo porterà fino alla capitale imperiale, Chang'an, sia lui che la persona che è incaricato di scortare finiranno nel mirino di diverse fazioni assetate di sangue e di potere.

episodes.title: Episodio 1
episodes.synopsis: On his way to Mo's, Dao Ma finds a bounty on a criminal called the Two-headed Snake. Though Mo warns Dao Ma of the danger of the task, Dao Ma does not have the luxury to refuse 6000 coins.

tmdb.title: Episodio 1
tmdb.synopsis: On his way to Mo's, Dao Ma finds a bounty on a criminal called the Two-headed Snake. Though Mo warns Dao Ma of the danger of the task, Dao Ma does not have the luxury to refuse 6000 coins.

episodes.title: Episodio 2
episodes.synopsis: In search of the Double-Headed Snake, Dao Ma reaches a town called Chisha. The town is being dictated by a Government Official Chang Guiren. He proposes Dao Ma to work in his battalion to keep the so-called rebellions at bay.

tmdb.title: Episodio 2
tmdb.synopsis: In search of the Double-Headed Snake, Dao Ma reaches a town called Chisha. The town is being dictated by a Government Official Chang Guiren. He proposes Dao Ma to work in his battalion to keep the so-called rebellions at bay.

episodes.title: Episodio 3
episodes.synopsis: After killing the government official of the Chisha, Dao Ma now has a 50,000 gold coins bounty on his head. He returns to Mo only to find a mysterious man waiting to seek his aid, named Zhi Shilang who wants to visit Chang'an.

tmdb.title: Episodio 3
tmdb.synopsis: After killing the government official of the Chisha, Dao Ma now has a 50,000 gold coins bounty on his head. He returns to Mo only to find a mysterious man waiting to seek his aid, named Zhi Shilang who wants to visit Chang'an.

episodes.title: Episodio 4
episodes.synopsis: On their way to Chang'an, Dao and the group notice a swordsman (Shu) fighting off Rakshasan-worshipers. Dao Ma offers to help the guy in exchange for his carriage. But the guy does not seem to be friendly at all.

tmdb.title: Episodio 4
tmdb.synopsis: On their way to Chang'an, Dao and the group notice a swordsman (Shu) fighting off Rakshasan-worshipers. Dao Ma offers to help the guy in exchange for his carriage. But the guy does not seem to be friendly at all.

episodes.title: Episodio 5
episodes.synopsis: Being cornered by the enemy Shu had to accept Dao Ma's help. It looks like Shu's destination is also Chang'an where he is to be returning a fugitive to his master.

tmdb.title: Episodio 5
tmdb.synopsis: Being cornered by the enemy Shu had to accept Dao Ma's help. It looks like Shu's destination is also Chang'an where he is to be returning a fugitive to his master.

episodes.title: Episodio 6
episodes.synopsis: The heads of the great five families are summoned by Pei Suji, by the imperial order. Lao Ma is against what the secretary of the emperor offers and he has to pay gravely for that.

tmdb.title: Episodio 6
tmdb.synopsis: The heads of the great five families are summoned by Pei Suji, by the imperial order. Lao Ma is against what the secretary of the emperor offers and he has to pay gravely for that.

episodes.title: Episodio 7
episodes.synopsis: Lao Mo is dead and Yuji encounters Ayuya in the middle of the road to make her his bride. Dao Ma is beside himself with rage.

tmdb.title: Episodio 7
tmdb.synopsis: Lao Mo is dead and Yuji encounters Ayuya in the middle of the road to make her his bride. Dao Ma is beside himself with rage.

episodes.title: Episodio 8
episodes.synopsis: Shu gets involved in Dao Ma's revenge battle. The heads of five families which has now become four are on the road for the blood of Zhi Shilang.

tmdb.title: Episodio 8
tmdb.synopsis: Shu gets involved in Dao Ma's revenge battle. The heads of five families which has now become four are on the road for the blood of Zhi Shilang.

episodes.title: Episodio 9
episodes.synopsis: The huge sandstorm disrupts Dao Ma's battle for revenge. But Ayuya decides to leave the group to seek her own personal revenge for her father.

tmdb.title: Episodio 9
tmdb.synopsis: The huge sandstorm disrupts Dao Ma's battle for revenge. But Ayuya decides to leave the group to seek her own personal revenge for her father.

episodes.title: Episodio 10
episodes.synopsis: Like the sandstorm she is, Ayuya turns back and kills two of her father's killers but gets outnumbered by the enemy soon. To save her and keep her master's wish, A Ni makes the ultimate sacrifice.

tmdb.title: Episodio 10
tmdb.synopsis: Like the sandstorm she is, Ayuya turns back and kills two of her father's killers but gets outnumbered by the enemy soon. To save her and keep her master's wish, A Ni makes the ultimate sacrifice.

episodes.title: Episodio 11
episodes.synopsis: Zhi Shilang explains his origin and goal. Dao Ma is adamant to get Ayuya back dead or alive.

episodes.title: Episodio 12
episodes.synopsis: General Pei rescues Ayuya but can not get out of the enemy's grasp yet. Dao Ma and the group plan an attack to get Ayuya back.

episodes.title: Episodio 13
episodes.synopsis: General Pei stands before the enemy all alone. Dao Ma and Shu are waiting patiently for the right moment to strike. Buddha's Calvary makes an unexpected move.

episodes.title: Episodio 14

episodes.title: Episodio 15
episodes.synopsis: After getting her revenge, Ayuya decides to part from Dao Ma and join the Buddha's Chivalry. Dao Ma, Shu, and Zhi Shilang move towards another destination.
